issues.description: The UML in the problem statement declares getNameAndTotalNumberOfStudents() with return type void, but elsewhere in the problem text it is specified to return a String of the format "LectureName (TotalNumberOfStudents)" and the solution implementation returns a String. This contradiction in the UML can confuse students about the correct method signature to implement.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the UML in problem_statement.md to declare getNameAndTotalNumberOfStudents(): String (instead of void) so it matches the textual description and the solution. Ensure any UML snippets and method listings consistently show the method returning String, and update any related lines/comments in the problem statement to avoid ambiguity.
